articles.summary: Expectations were low for the Golden State Valkyries, the W.N.B.A.’s first expansion team in 17 years, but they captivated Bay Area sports fans and surprised the league by securing a playoff spot in their first season.
articles.title: Inside the Golden State Valkyries, the Most Valuable Team in Women’s Sports

articles.summary: The chief judge of the Rwandan genocide tribunal has concluded that Israel is guilty of the “crime of crimes” in Gaza.
articles.title: My U.N. Commission’s Finding: Israel Is Committing Genocide
